Enables pinch-to-zoom and rotation gestures in command panel mode, but uses more data and memory. Off by default (loads 1920px resolution).
When showing fullscreen or slideshow, crop images to fill screen if orientations match

When enabled: In fullscreen or slideshow mode, if the image and device have matching orientations (both landscape or both portrait), the image will be cropped to fill the entire screen. When disabled: All images will fit within the screen boundaries without cropping.
Show random photos during audio playback
When enabled, random photos from the selected resource will be displayed during audio playback. Each song displays one random photo. Only static images are used (videos are ignored).

Organize your media and other files efficiently:

• Browse photos, videos, GIFs, and audio
• Sort and filter by name, date, or size
• Copy/move with touch gestures
• Local, network (SMB/S/FTP), and cloud storage
• Up to 30 quick destination folders
• Slideshow mode

Let's get started!

Supported resource types:

📱 LOCAL: Device storage, SD cards

🌐 NETWORK: SMB/CIFS, SFTP, FTP

☁️ CLOUD: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox

Setup content of resources in Settings.
Touch Zones (Images/Video)\nuse in full screen view mode
Player uses 9 touch zones (3×3 grid) for quick actions. Tap zones to navigate, copy, move, delete files, or access the command panel. See the scheme above for details.

RESOURCES: Add folders from local storage, network shares, or cloud services.

DESTINATIONS: Set up to 30 quick-access folders with color coding for fast copy/move operations.

Configure in Settings anytime!

📝 TEXT & PDF: View and edit text files, export PDF pages to JPG

🔤 OCR & TRANSLATION: Extract text from images and translate to your language

📚 EPUB: Read e-books with adjustable font size

🎵 AUDIO: Play music with album covers from iTunes

✨ And much more to discover!

Setup in Settings next...

Auto-advance time for images in slideshow mode. Range: 1-3600 seconds. Video files play to end or respect this timer based on settings.
Thumbnail size in pixels for grid view. Default: 96dp. Range: 32-256dp (increments of 8dp).
Quick sort targets for fast file organization. Maximum 30 destinations. Each has a number and color for easy identification.

9 invisible zones (3×3 grid) for gesture control in fullscreen mode. Left/Center/Right and Top/Middle/Bottom combinations trigger different actions like navigation, file operations, and panel control.
Confirm before destructive operations. When enabled, app asks for confirmation before deleting or moving files to prevent accidental data loss.
Mark important files as favorites for quick access. Favorite files can be viewed in a separate list and added to home screen widget.
Keeps the screen on while viewing media files. Prevents device from sleeping or dimming during playback or viewing sessions.
Reduces the size of player control buttons for a more minimalist interface. Useful on smaller screens or when you prefer less intrusive controls.
Default username and password used when connecting to network resources (SMB/SFTP/FTP). Can be overridden per-resource during configuration.

Show ALL file types in resources (not just media). When enabled, automatically enables support for images, video, audio, GIF, text, PDF, and EPUB files. Use this for file management beyond just media viewing.

Display hidden files and folders (those starting with a dot). When enabled, all files including system and configuration files will be visible in file listings.

Filter video files by size (in KB). Set minimum and maximum values to show only videos within the specified size range.
Filter audio files by size (in MB). Set minimum and maximum values to show only audio files within the specified size range.
When enabled, music files from the selected resource will play in random order during image/GIF slideshows. Choose a resource that contains your music collection.
Shows line numbers when viewing text files. Useful for code review, editing, and referencing specific lines in documents.
Enables real-time text translation feature for images. Translates visible text from source to target language using online translation service.
Displays translated text in separate blocks instead of overlaying on original image. Provides clearer reading experience for longer translations.
Go to Next File After Copying
Automatically advances to the next file after successfully copying current file. Speeds up batch sorting workflow by eliminating manual navigation.
Opens the command panel automatically when entering media viewer. Panel provides quick access to copy, move, delete, and other file operations.

FastMediaSorter is designed for fast media sorting. To delete and move files with one tap (without confirmation dialogs), the app needs \"Media Management\" permission.\n\nWithout this permission, Android will show a confirmation dialog for each file operation.

⚠️ Without "All files access" permission, Android restricts folder selection to only standard folders (Documents, Downloads, Pictures).

✅ With this permission, you can:
• Choose ANY folder on your device
• Access Pictures, DCIM, Camera folders
• Select custom folders for organizing media

🔒 Privacy: The app only uses this for browsing your media - no data is collected or uploaded.

Grant permission in the next screen to unlock full folder access.

⚠️ Limited Folder Access

Without "All files access" permission, you can only select from standard Android folders.

To choose any folder on your device, please grant the permission when prompted.
